crossRefs.note: They also who seek after my life lay snares. Those who seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all…
All day long they twist my words. All their thoughts are against me for evil.
They conspire and lurk, watching my steps. They are eager to take my life.
The proud have hidden a snare for me, they have spread the cords of a net by the path. They have set traps for me.
who cause a person to be indicted by a word, and lay a snare for the arbiter in the gate, and who deprive the innocent…
Then they said, “Come! Let’s devise plans against Jeremiah; for the law won’t perish from the priest, nor counsel from…
Then the Pharisees went and took counsel how they might entrap him in his talk.
They sent their disciples to him, along with the Herodians, saying, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and teach…
lying in wait for him, and seeking to catch him in something he might say, that they might accuse him.
They watched him and sent out spies, who pretended to be righteous, that they might trap him in something he said, so…
The Pharisees went out, and immediately conspired with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.
He warned them, saying, “Take heed: beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and the yeast of Herod.”
Jesus said to them, “Take heed and beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”

translations.web: They sent some of the Pharisees and the Herodians to him, that they might trap him with words.
translations.bsb: Later, they sent some of the Pharisees and Herodians to catch Jesus in His words.
translations.kjv: And they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, to catch him in his words.
translations.asv: And they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, that they might catch him in talk.
